title: chore: delete the ovh image origin and vm-only shared modules
author: ElliotEtag

gist.summary: Removed the OVH VM image origin path after the image cache Worker had handled every request since 2026-10-12 23:33 UTC. The Worker generates cache misses itself; the VM proxy, legacy headers and origin configuration, old image app and GPU server code, and VM-only shared modules were removed. Configured image-origin.pollinations.ai as a Worker custom domain while retaining the same free limit and paywall. The shared folder now contains only modules imported by the two cache Workers, and backend CI runs their cache tests when shared files change. Text and image test suites passed 69 and 60 tests respectively; both production dry runs showed the expected bindings.
